reason: A CLI-oriented runtime for authoring, validating, staging, activating, updating, and recovering managed plugin profile packs with explicit confirmation and provenance checks.

summaries.zh: 用于创建、验证、签名、部署、更新和回滚受管理插件配置包的命令行运行时。
summaries.en: A command-line runtime for creating, validating, signing, deploying, updating, and rolling back managed plugin profile packs.

capabilities: Composes and validates portable profile packs
Plans and applies plugin and preset changes to managed runtime profiles
Stages, activates, confirms, updates, and rolls back named profile generations
Handles source pinning, license inventory, hashes, and publisher signature verification
